About Maria

Nutrition knowledge with real culinary experience.

Healthy eating should not feel like punishment. It should be tasty, beautiful and realistic for everyday life.

My name is Maria Nychyporenko. I have been studying nutrition since 2015, when I completed my first nutrition course in Ireland. In 2023–2024 I continued my education at Dr. Ekaterina Tolstikova’s School of Dietetics.

I also have many years of professional culinary experience. I worked as a chef in restaurants in Italy and Ireland, and cooking has been my passion for most of my life.

This is my main strength: I understand not only nutrition, but also real food, taste, recipes and everyday cooking. I can create healthy menus from the foods you already love.

Why nutrition matters

Every meal has an effect on the body.

Every day we eat several times, often without thinking how strongly food affects the body. Many people connect health problems only with genetics, stress, age or the environment, while one of the most important daily factors is often overlooked: what they put on their plate.

Food influences energy, metabolism, body weight, mood, digestion and long-term health. Every meal can either support the body or gradually work against it.

Nutrition does not replace medical care, but it is one of the strongest tools we use every single day to support health and quality of life.

Metabolic health

Support for weight management, obesity, insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes lifestyle changes.

Energy & mood

Better food structure can support stable energy, emotional balance and reduced fatigue.

Women’s health

Nutrition support for peri-menopause, menopause, cravings, body composition and long-term wellness.
